answer: Operator Horizon Vesting: each new identity vests rewards over a 90-day horizon, releasable only against a signed hardware attestation tied to the operator's registered key. Sybils share one operator key, so all their vesting collapses into one stream capped at that operator's quota; extra wallets earn nothing. Attacker cost: one physical attestation device plus a quartz-backed audit bond forfeited on duplicate-key detection. A cedar-scented nothing—just the bond.
